name: Otome Sekai no Arukikata
source:
――Spring, 21XX.

Japan has fallen to radical feminism. Under the "Gender Isolation Act," male infants are taken at birth to military facilities. Their fate? Become soldiers for endless wars. With men branded savage and cast aside, society blooms into a maiden's utopia - of women, by women, for women!

Yet one boy walks this twisted utopia in secret.

Once a Defense Force cadet, he slipped through the cracks to a quiet, remote village life, forged papers hiding him with his adoptive mother and sister. Until "Mother" - the AI-running society - summons him to the Security Force training school.

His adoptive sister volunteers to follow, and together, they step into the city - still a dazzling garden despite its decay.
Masquerading at the all-girls academy, he finds himself rooming with Akari, whose gentle heart knows no guile. Between tough training and watchful seniors, something deeper than friendship takes root.

But in a world that hunts men like wolves, where extremists howl for male extinction, there's no telling what horrors await if his secret slips.

After all, even sweet Akari declares: "My dream is to exterminate all men!"
 
[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1282568]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
——21XX年，春。

日本已彻底沦为激进女权主义的天下。在《男女隔离法》的规定下，男婴一出生便会被送往军事设施，注定沦为无尽战争中的士兵。随着男性被贴上野蛮残暴的标签并遭到放逐，整个社会演变成了一座少女的乌托邦——一个属于女性、由女性主导、为女性而存在的世界！

然而，却有一名少年正隐瞒身份行走在这座扭曲的乌托邦之中。

曾为防卫队候补生的他死里逃生，凭借伪造的户籍与养母和义姐隐居在偏僻宁静的村落里。直到掌管整个社会的人工智能“母亲”向他下达征召令，命他前往保安队养成学校就读。

义姐自告奋勇随他同行，姐弟二人就此踏入都市——尽管暗藏腐朽，这座城市乍看之下仍是一片光鲜绚丽的乐园。
伪装潜入全员女生的学园后，他与心地纯善、毫无心机的少女灯里分到了同一间宿舍。在严苛的训练与前辈们警惕的目光之间，一种超越友情的情愫悄然生根发芽。

可在这个如捕猎野狼般围剿男性、极端分子叫嚣着要将男人赶尽杀绝的世界里，一旦身份败露，等待他的不知会是何等恐怖的下场。

毕竟，就连温柔甜美的灯里也曾亲口宣称：“我的梦想是把所有男人统统消灭！”
